headline: Sensex jumps over 500 points led by FII inflows, banking and FMCG stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) staged a strong buying comeback to drive market gains.
Banking and FMCG stocks rallied, supporting the overall index surge.
Coal India announced a ₹1 trillion diversification plan using proceeds from the MCL IPO.
Positive early trading cues lifted Nifty near the 25,300 mark.
whatHappening: Sensex closed up over 500 points while Nifty50 ended near 25,291.
Max Healthcare emerged as the top gainer during the market session.
ITC, Bharti Airtel, and Asian Paints led early market gains.
SEBI set up a sub-group under PMAC to review key IPO norms.
summary: Indian stock markets surged on November 16 as the Sensex rallied over 500 points and Nifty closed near 25,290. Strong foreign institutional buying along with gains in FMCG and banking stocks powered the market rally. Top gainers included Max Healthcare, ITC, Bharti Airtel, and Asian Paints.
